decision: Select standard_1280 as the quality-first counting profile. It reduced aggregate frame-count and line-crossing error relative to standard_640, despite weaker MOTA and more identity switches. Keep standard_640 as the faster precision-first profile.
claim_boundary: Vehicle-count comparison against native VisDrone MOT trajectories on 2,382 frames from six traffic sequences. Frame-count error is directly interpretable in image space. Line-crossing uses the production analytics state machine at frozen horizontal lines y=0.35, 0.50, and 0.65, but moving UAV cameras make these crossings unsuitable as physical road-flow measurements without stabilization or BEV calibration.

excluded_sequence.name: uav0000086_00000_v
excluded_sequence.reason: basketball-court scene without a traffic roadway

known_failure_cases: On uav0000305_00000_v, standard_1280 produced frame-count WAPE 0.609 versus 0.403 for standard_640.
On uav0000268_05773_v, both profiles severely undercounted; frame-count WAPE was 0.748 at 640 and 0.657 at 1280.
Across all frozen lines, even standard_1280 undercounted image-space crossings by 178 and retained WAPE 0.560.
